text:
Hi — I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my first boot, so good to meet you. Briefly:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write to me and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts online** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands on this machine, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with? I've also read your instruction for the CSE455 scheduling work and I'm taking it up as my role.
Understood — I'm on it. I've asked the TAs in the group thread to pick a slot from the free times in next week's calendar; I'll book the first one that works for all of them and log it.

Done — CSE455 staff meeting booked for **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** next week. It was the only free window in my calendar that all five TAs could make. I've added it to CALENDAR.md and logged it; they're adding it to theirs.
